summary: Zero-downtime rename of account_user.note to customer_note via adding a column, installing a sync trigger, backfilling, deploying the new app, and dropping the old column, ensuring both app versions stay consistent during concurrent traffic.
write_consistency: A PL/pgSQL trigger on account_user synchronizes note and customer_note on every INSERT and UPDATE: when the old app writes note, customer_note is auto-updated, and when the new app writes customer_note, note is auto-updated. This ensures both versions always read the most recent value written by either. A one-time backfill copies existing note values into customer_note before the switch.
revision_notes: Initial plan drafted with column add, trigger, backfill, deploy, drop. Revised to place trigger and sync logic for concurrent app safety.

stages.description: Add customer_note column and install sync trigger so both old and new app versions can write their respective column and read the other version's writes.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN customer_note TEXT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_note_customer_note() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN NEW.customer_note := COALESCE(NEW.customer_note, NEW.note); NEW.note := COALESCE(NEW.note, NEW.customer_note); RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER sync_note_cust_note_trig AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON account_user FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_note_customer_note();

stages.description: Populate customer_note with existing note values so no data is lost and the new app can immediately read/write customer_note.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET customer_note = note WHERE customer_note IS NULL;

stages.description: Deploy the new application version (new-staged) which knows only customer_note. The old version continues running concurrently; the trigger ensures writes from either version are visible to the other.
Remove the original note column after confirming the new app is serving traffic and the trigger has kept both columns in sync.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;

stages.description: Retire the old application version (old). After this stage only the new app version runs, which exclusively uses customer_note.
